title: Florida Man Haunts Family on Halloween-Eve: Cops
description:
A man was arrested after he was allegedly found at a home he had been trespassed from in Lake County, Florida. Police found Timothy Rogers, 35, outside of a home where he allegedly had a no-contact order in place with one of the residents over a domestic issue, and this was not the first time. When police arrived, body cam footage shows Rogers stumbling over his words and claiming he was there for a “bike,” but police weren’t fooled and took the suspected prowler straight to jail. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
